sentences.text: Your boat needs the right paperwork too, not just you.
A boat of five net tons or more, carrying passengers for hire between American points, must be documented by the Coast Guard with a coastwise endorsement.
That endorsement also has rules about where the boat was built and who owns her.
Smaller boats are simply registered with the state.
In Florida there’s one more piece.
A charter fishing operation needs the right saltwater charter license from the Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission.
That license covers your customers, so they don’t each need their own.
And carry it all aboard: your credential, the boat’s papers, and the required placards.
When the Coast Guard boards you, and one day they will, what do they ask for first?
Your license and the boat’s documents.
Have them where you can reach them in ten seconds.
